title: The TLC shards
description: Each shard runs one spec with one config. A shard runs when a changed path matches the paths that it covers.

always.description: Paths whose change runs every shard. A pattern ending in /** matches every path under that directory.

covers.description: Paths of the code that a shard models, unless the shard names its own covers.

shards.description: The shards, in run order. The small shards come first, so a mistake fails early.

covers.description: Paths of the code that this shard models. They replace the shared covers.

paths.description: Paths that only this shard covers, in addition to its covers.
